title: The algebraic theory of non-archimedean intertwining periods
summary: We develop an algebraic theory of local intertwining periods for symmetric pairs $(G,H,θ)$ over non-archimedean local fields $F$ of characteristic different from $2$, and finite-length representations of Levi subgroups of $G$ with coefficients in an algebraically closed field $R$ of characteristic different from the residual characteristic of $F$. For open orbits this algebraic version is essentially contained in the work of Blanc and Delorme.
